title: Конструктор будущего
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Create ONE coherent high quality VISUAL DIRECTION BOARD for a family's co-op videogame universe in year 65382. Landscape high resolution 2304x1536 or similar. This is a proposed new visual language, not a full archive redraw.
REFERENCE ROLES: Image1 Alpha planet SHAPE reference (three vertical oceans/waterfalls and fourteen orbital protective spheres). Image2 Snowflake SHAPE reference (blue soft rounded wings and long central fuselage). Image3 triangular BMW SHAPE reference (triangular open-frame spacecraft, oval rear module, glowing safe black-hole core, small pod). Image4 flying house SHAPE reference (rectangular multiple floors on round levitating platform, 20 tiny craft in hangar). Image5 LEVKA SHAPE reference (round small world with several simple tall house/tower forms, pointed tops and oval surface marks; do NOT turn it into a lion, cat or human).
ADDITIONAL ESTABLISHED DESIGNS to depict from this description: alternate BMW is a tall open rectangular supporting frame, wide stepped upper deck, large inverted cone hanging down from deck, oval energy core suspended beneath cone. Foggy Albion is a misty rocky planet with an illuminated domed base. Family flag has a long-haired long-bearded Mendeleev portrait silhouette, motif representing125 planets, and exact text A1 HO HE RO. VORA currency has crescent+nearby star symbol and an ancient anonymous figure motif; denominations1,10,100. Xbox device is a tall rectangular console with two pullout controller trays, one each side.
ABSOLUTE CHANGE: remove ALL antique, parchment, aged book, watercolor, engraved baroque, brass/steampunk, classical serif features. Everything should feel far future and playable, inspired by Roblox's friendly volumetric geometry and shared playful spaces, but original character and asset design, no Roblox logos, no Mario characters.
BOARD CONTENT in an orderly editorial grid with generous gutters:
Header number/title and 'МЕНДЕЛЕЕВЫ · 65382'.
Upper wide hero panel: Alpha as dominant planet, smaller Foggy Albion and LEVKA nearby with tiny plain labels; recognizable shapes translated into this direction.
Middle strip: recognizable blue Snowflake; triangular BMW with black-hole core; alternate inverted-cone BMW; flying house — four legible silhouettes, not generic rockets.
Lower asset strip: a redesigned futuristic VORA token/card with crescent/star and 1,10,100 samples; family flag retaining portrait/symbol content but executed as futuristic insignia; an Xbox-like tall device with side controller drawers and a safe energy black-hole orb.
Lower right inset PLAYABLE SCENE MOCKUP: exactly four small friendly original blocky explorers distinguished by blue, coral, mint and yellow suits, cooperating on one shared planetary path/platform. Simple readable UI with four player chips and one large button 'ЛЕТИМ ВМЕСТЕ'. This is an illustrative proposed gameplay screen only.
Include a compact palette of five swatches and a Cyrillic typography sample 'АЛЬФА / Летим вместе / 1234' rendered in the direction's clear sans serif.
Text only the described headings/short labels, legible Russian, no paragraphs. Keep the SAME subject set across directions for fair comparison. The three planets must be distinct worlds, not merged. No weapons, no realistic human portraits except simplified flag silhouette.
DIRECTION 01 title '01 / КОНСТРУКТОР БУДУЩЕГО'. Closest to Roblox: bold chunky low-poly volumetric shapes, modular toy-like construction, beveled cube geometry, simple silhouettes, matte polymer with bright emissive seams. Primary saturated cobalt blue, mint, coral, yellow on pale cool blue background. Clean soft studio illumination, fun and tactile, some intentionally blocky terrain. Full contemporary 3D render, not painted. UI solid rounded rectangular tiles, thick highly legible rounded geometric sans, playful but not preschool. VORA is a chunky rectangular translucent credit chip, flag a flat bright graphic textile/sign. Sparse clean detail, strong mobile-game readability.
refinement_prompt: Use case: style-transfer. EDIT this entire visual direction board. Keep the exact layout, Russian text, colors, objects and recognizable silhouettes, but make a RADICAL art-style shift to genuinely chunky simple Roblox-like LOW-POLY toy 3D, visually distinct from cinematic realistic sci-fi. This is '01 / КОНСТРУКТОР БУДУЩЕГО'. Replace the overly detailed realistic sci-fi render everywhere with simple broad facets, beveled rectangular blocks, matte plastic, limited five-color palette, crisp ambient occlusion. Terrain made of a few chunky modular platforms, low-poly polygonal trees, waterfalls simple clean blue shapes with three broad white bands. Aircraft recognizable but ONLY 5-12 major geometric pieces each, no small greebles/panel lines/photo metallic detail. Snowflake blue round fuselage and two wings; triangular BMW as thick triangular frame and disk with simple glowing core; inverted cone BMW simplified wide roof/2legs/cone; flying house composed of large stackable room boxes on a saucer. The bookish/vintage look remains completely absent. Four explorers must have chunky rectangular torso/limbs, rounded cubic heads and minimal friendly faces, no finger detail, generic original toy avatars. Currency thicker colorful blocky chips, flag flat geometric icon design. Levka small rounded block planet with five simple tall pointed block towers following sketch. Alpha round world retains three water channels. Make it feel achievable as a bright family 3D game made of modular building blocks, not an expensive realistic spaceship movie. Every cell should reflect the simpler geometric style. Keep header and type sample bold rounded block sans. No new text.
